pool.notes: THE LIVE suffix sites (this list is what economicState.primaryExports becomes at economicState.js :811-812). Stress set is config.stressTypes + config.intendedStressTypes (economicState.js :759) — wider than economicState's own suffix sites, which read stressTypes only. Order: transit suffix is applied BEFORE the stress map, so a transit good under siege/occupation carries TWO tags ("X (transit) (taxed by occupation)" — goodsCatalog.js :: preferTradeLabel comments on exactly this). Each suffix is to become a `kind` field (transit | naval-only | occupation-taxed).

rows.notes: Condition: active chain with chain.entrepot && status != impaired; first food-record-held output (slice 0,1). producer: the chain's, elsewhere.
Condition: stress under_siege AND (worldLaw.supportsMaritime() ?? route === port); list cut to 3. Else under siege the list is EMPTY.
Condition: occupied and NOT under_siege; list cut to 5.

The unsuffixed export rows (raw resource tradeGoods + chain outputs) print only when neither under_siege nor occupied, but print plainly under every OTHER crisis (famine is handled by goodsHeldByFoodRecord). Declared calm only to state the pool opt-in; the real exclusion is {under_siege, occupied}.
